blocks.prompt: 7. When the polynomial \(4x^{4} + 2x^{3} + kx^{2} + 13\) is divided by \(x + 1\), the remainder is 16. Find the value of \(k\).
blocks.explanation:
Is polynomial ka ek coefficient \(k\) maloom nahi, lekin humein remainder bata diya gaya hai: 16.
Remainder theorem kehta hai ke \(x + 1\) se divide karne par remainder \(f(-1)\) hota hai.
Plan: \(f(-1)\) nikalna (\(k\) ko letter hi rehne dena), us ko 16 ke barabar rakhna, aur \(k\) ki simple equation hal karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 4x^{4} + 2x^{3} + kx^{2} + 13\), divisor \(x + 1\), remainder 16.
Humein find karna hai: \(k\).
Tareeqa: Remainder theorem: \(x - a\) se divide karne par remainder \(f(a)\) hota hai. Is tareeqe se humein division karni hi nahi parti, sirf ek value rakhni hai.

\(a\) pehchanein
\[x + 1 = x - (-1)\]
\[a = -1\]
Kyun: Theorem \(x - a\) ki shakal mangta hai. \(x + 1\) ko \(x - (-1)\) likha to \(a = -1\). Aasaan tareeqa: \(x + 1 = 0\) se \(x = -1\).
Dhyan dein: \(x + 1\) dekh kar \(a = 1\) rakh dena bohat aam ghalti hai.

\(f(-1)\) nikalein
\[f(-1) = 4(-1)^{4} + 2(-1)^{3} + k(-1)^{2} + 13\]
\[= 4 - 2 + k + 13\]
\[= k + 15\]
Kyun: \(-1\) ki even power 1 hoti hai aur odd power \(-1\): \((-1)^{4} = 1\), \((-1)^{3} = -1\), \((-1)^{2} = 1\). Phir numbers jama kiye: \(4 - 2 + 13 = 15\), aur \(k\) ko waise hi rehne diya kyunke woh abhi maloom nahi.

Diye gaye remainder se equation banayein
\[k + 15 = 16\]
\[k = 1\]
Kyun: Remainder \(f(-1)\) hai aur sawal ne remainder 16 bataya hai, is liye dono barabar. 15 ko doosri taraf le gaye to \(k = 16 - 15 = 1\).

Tasdeeq
\[f(-1) = 4 - 2 + 1 + 13\]
\[= 16 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(k = 1\) rakh kar dobara \(f(-1)\) nikala to wohi 16 aaya jo sawal mein diya tha. Is liye \(k = 1\) sahi hai.
